schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE PRODUCT (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    PRODUCT_NAME VARCHAR(255),
    UNIT_PRICE INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (UNIT_PRICE > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE SALES (
    PRODUCT_ID INT,
    SELLER_ID INT,
    BUYER_ID INT,
    SALE_DATE DATE,
    QUANTITY INT,
    PRICE INT,
    FOREIGN KEY (PRODUCT_ID) REFERENCES PRODUCT(PRODUCT_ID),
    CHECK (QUANTITY > 0),
    CHECK (PRICE > 0)
);
q1: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2: SELECT PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT JOIN SALES ON PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID = SALES.PRODUCT_ID AND (SALES.SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALES.SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31') )
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID FROM SALES GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID HAVING MIN(SALE_DATE) >= '2019-01-01' AND MAX(SALE_DATE) <= '2019-03-31' ) S ON (P.PRODUCT_ID = S.PRODUCT_ID)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID NOT IN ( SELECT PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID FROM PRODUCT JOIN SALES ON PRODUCT.PRODUCT_ID = SALES.PRODUCT_ID AND (SALES.SALE_DATE < '2019-01-01' OR SALES.SALE_DATE > '2019-03-31') )
counterexample: INSERT INTO PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, UNIT_PRICE) VALUES (1, 'Laptop', 1000); INSERT INTO SALES (PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_ID, BUYER_ID, SALE_DATE, QUANTITY, PRICE) VALUES (1, 101, 201, '2018-12-31', 1, 900), (1, 102, 202, '2019-02-15', 1, 1100);
explanation: Q1 selects products that have sales within the specified date range, while Q2 selects products that do not have sales outside the specified date range. The difference arises when a product has sales both inside and outside the date range.
counterexample_dsp: A product with sales on '2018-12-31' (outside the date range) and '2019-02-15' (inside the date range) will be included in Q1 but excluded from Q2.
